# Scotch'n'Soda Theatre
> Scotch'n'Soda Theatre is one of the nation's oldest student theater groups, and is one of the oldest and largest student organizations at Carnegie Mellon University. 

## Current Season
- [Shows](https://www.snstheatre.org/season): Description of our current season of shows

## Learn More
- [About](https://www.snstheatre.org/about): Learn more details about the organizations and its various subgroups
